name: EEB 5301
title: Population and Community Ecology
description: Overview of population and community ecology, including population regulation and dynamics, metapopulations, species interactions, biodiversity, community structure, and evolutionary ecology. Theoretical and case-history approaches, emphasizing plants, invertebrates, and vertebrates. Lecture, discussion, and exercises in analysis and modeling.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in EEB, others with consent.
